description: Local: Tricot Countertop Color, Solid Surface header with Technolite / Technomat from configurator 12 GBMaterial (R-TRICOT-CT-003), Glass header in the grid, full mode. Read-only, guarded.

args.function: async () => { const d = document.querySelector('[role=dialog][aria-label="Countertop Color"]'); d?.querySelector('button[class*=closeBtn]')?.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600)); return { closed: !document.querySelector('[role=dialog][aria-label="Countertop Color"]') }; }
